subject: ModifyNonCirculatingSupply
reference lead: fields token, add u64, remove u64
bytes: the action holds a token and two user lists (20 byte keys), each at most 10000 long; the body inserts all of the first list, then removes all of the second

subject: circulating supply
bytes: 0x375e4c0 builds it: max minus token_fees_collected, minus the sum over non-circulating users, then minus native_token_reserve for the native token
case: summary all four sources in order

subject: list length cap
bytes: both lists are refused above 10000 with tag 0x143, after the token bound
case: arm a bad token beats lengths

subject: burn users
bytes: the zero address and the 0x...dead address are always counted, and a set member equal to one of them counts twice
case: summary zero user in the set counts twice

subject: token 1
bytes: token id 1 reports max + 4e13 in the top word only; total and circulating do not move, and the add is checked with tag 0xbe
case: summary bonus token adds to the top word only

subject: native staking
bytes: for the native token each counted user also adds the first three words of slot 0x5774f18; the fourth word is ignored
case: summary native fourth word is not counted
